page.title: Users
page.subtitle: Manage the people of this company: roles, departments, sections and status

form.createDescription: Add a person to this company with at least one role.
form.editDescription: Only the fields you change are saved.
form.name: Name
form.passwordEditHint: Leave empty to keep the current password. Changing it signs the person out of their other sessions.
form.currentPasswordHint: Needed only when you change your own password.
form.rolesHint: You can only give roles whose permissions you hold yourself.
form.noSections: The chosen departments have no sections.
form.selfLocked: You can't change your own roles, departments or sections.

errors.nameTooLong: The name can't be longer than 255 characters.
errors.emailTooLong: The email can't be longer than 255 characters.
errors.passwordTooShort: The password must be at least {{min}} characters.
errors.passwordTooLong: The password can't be longer than 255 characters.
errors.currentPasswordRequired: Enter your current password to change it.

activate.title: Activate user?
activate.description: “{{name}}” will be able to use this company again.

deactivate.title: Deactivate user?
deactivate.description: “{{name}}” will be blocked from this company. Their data is kept and you can activate them again.

delete.title: Move to trash?
delete.description: “{{name}}” will be signed out and moved to the trash. You can restore them later.

restore.title: Restore user?
restore.description: “{{name}}” will be brought back from the trash.

force_delete.title: Delete permanently?
force_delete.description: “{{name}}” will be removed for good and this can't be undone. Their documents, versions and tasks must be moved or deleted first.

delete.title: Move {{count}} users to the trash?
delete.description: They will be signed out. If any selected user can't be deleted, nothing is changed.

restore.title: Restore {{count}} users?
restore.description: If any selected user can't be restored, nothing is changed.

force_delete.title: Permanently delete {{count}} users?
force_delete.description: They are removed for good and this can't be undone. Their documents and tasks must be moved first. If any can't be deleted, nothing is changed.
